description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_3DModel"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/3d-model">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChangeInstructions" name="Change instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_STL" name="STL model"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DModel">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist" processRef="Process_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Send sketches"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Start_ArtistSketches"
                      messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Changes" name="Send change instructions"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Start_ArtistChanges"
                      messageRef="Message_ChangeInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialSTL" name="Send STL"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendInitialSTL" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"
                      messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RevisedSTL" name="Send revised STL"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendRevisedSTL" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"
                      messageRef="Message_STL"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct an artist and print a 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Craving" name="Crave a custom 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstructArtist" name="Instruct artist to create a project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSTL" name="Receive STL model" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewModel" name="Review model"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with result?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Send change instructions" messageRef="Message_ChangeInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorAtHome" name="Color at home?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAmount" name="Check amount of color left"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Amount" name="Under 100 grams?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddShoppingList" name="Add color to shopping list"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderPlastic" name="Order plastic"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorMerge" name="Continue with plastic" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare printer and generate gcode"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TurnOnPrinter" name="Turn on 3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatPrinter" name="Heat bed and extruder"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate gcode from STL"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Printer ready and gcode generated" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrintingComplete" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Craving" targetRef="Task_InstructArtist"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" targetRef="Task_ReviewModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_ReviewModel" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SatisfiedYes" name="Satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">satisfied</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SatisfiedNo" name="Not satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendChanges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not satisfied</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_ColorAtHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorAtHome" name="At home" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorAtHome" targetRef="Task_CheckAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorAtHome</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorNotAtHome" name="Not at home" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorAtHome" targetRef="Task_OrderPlastic">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not colorAtHome</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_8" sourceRef="Task_CheckAmount" targetRef="Gateway_Amount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Under100" name="Under 100 grams" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Task_AddShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">remainingGrams < 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AtLeast100" name="100 grams or more" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Gateway_ColorMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_9" sourceRef="Task_AddShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_ColorMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_10" sourceRef="Task_OrderPlastic" targetRef="Gateway_ColorMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_11" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationPrinter" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_12" sourceRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter" targetRef="Task_HeatPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_13" sourceRef="Task_HeatPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationGcode" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_14" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_15" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_16" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="End_PrintingComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Artist" name="Create and revise 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ArtistSketches" name="Receive sketches">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ArtistSketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProject" name="Create project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInitialSTL" name="Send STL model" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_InitialModelSent" name="Initial model sent"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ArtistChanges" name="Receive change instructions">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ArtistChanges" messageRef="Message_ChangeInstructions"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviseProject" name="Revise project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRevisedSTL" name="Send revised STL model" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RevisedModelSent" name="Revised model sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_1" sourceRef="Start_ArtistSketches" targetRef="Task_CreateProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_2" sourceRef="Task_CreateProject" targetRef="Task_SendInitialSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_3" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialSTL" targetRef="End_InitialModelSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_4" sourceRef="Start_ArtistChanges" targetRef="Task_ReviseProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_5" sourceRef="Task_ReviseProject" targetRef="Task_SendRevisedSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_6" sourceRef="Task_SendRevisedSTL" targetRef="End_RevisedModelSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
